comment: Phase 2d original houses and low-rises (decision log D-p2d-1 to D-p2d-5): each placed with createbuilding at its max floors and no cellar on a superflat world, one every two chunks along z=0. Not run by the lane; for the batched review.
title: Phase 2d: original houses and low-rises

shots.name: nh_house_garden-se
shots.caption: nh_house_garden, 2 floors, from the south-east: brick and spruce house, gable roof, fenced garden.

shots.name: nh_house_garden-nw
shots.caption: nh_house_garden from the north-west: back door, gates and chimney.

shots.name: nh_cottage-se
shots.caption: nh_cottage, 1 floor, from the south-east: whitewash and spruce frame, brick-tile roof, vegetable plot.

shots.name: nh_cottage-nw
shots.caption: nh_cottage from the north-west: front flower garden and door.

shots.name: nh_corner_shop-se
shots.caption: nh_corner_shop, 3 floors, from the south-east: storefronts in the style wall, red fascia, flats above, parapet.

shots.name: nh_corner_shop-nw
shots.caption: nh_corner_shop from the north-west: the other two storefronts and the roof chimney.

shots.name: nh_workshop-se
shots.caption: nh_workshop, 2 floors, from the south-east: stone brick, roller door, strip windows, sawtooth roof.

shots.name: nh_workshop-nw
shots.caption: nh_workshop from the north-west: office ribbon windows and the sawtooth glazing.

shots.name: nh_walkup-se
shots.caption: nh_walkup, 3 floors, from the south-east: brick flats, stone quoins and sills, water tank.

shots.name: nh_walkup-nw
shots.caption: nh_walkup from the north-west: rear wall and the cornice.

shots.name: overview
shots.caption: All five original buildings in a row, west to east, seen from the south and above.
